text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MX-012","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 55"}],"comment":"Dimension D9 (⌀ 55) defines the major diameter of the M12 thread feature F1 but carries no tolerance, leaving only the general machining tolerance which is far too coarse for a functional mating thread. The designer should add an appropriate thread class or tolerance to this dimension.","recommended_correction":"Add a thread tolerance designation (e.g., 6g) to D9 or replace it with a standard thread callout that includes the tolerance class."},{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"KEYWAYS SHOULD BE INLINE IN 0.05 MM & TO BE DONE IN ONE SETTING"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"35±0.1"}],"comment":"Note N3 requires keyways to be inline within 0.05 mm, but the only keyway length dimension shown is D4 (35±0.1) for a single keyway slot (F2), and no second keyway exists on the drawing to be aligned. This note contradicts the drawing content and will confuse the machinist about what features must be held to 0.05 mm alignment. The designer should either remove N3 or add the missing second keyway and its alignment dimension.","recommended_correction":"Remove note N3 if only one keyway exists, or add the second keyway feature and its positional/alignment dimensions to the drawing."}]}
